QUOTE: Before the network call, the post is written to the local WatermelonDB with a temporary `pending_post_id` and an id equal to it, so it shows in the UI immediately. ... Any other error: the post is re-saved with `props.failed = true`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states the post is saved to the local DB before the network call and, on failure, kept with `props.failed = true`.
